newsitem.title: USA: Gliatech filing accepted by FDA.
newsitem.headline: Gliatech filing accepted by FDA.

text.p: Gliatech Inc said on Thursday that its premarket approval application for ADCON-L has been accepted by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.

"The acceptance of the ADCON-L PMA filing represents a signficant step toward eventual market clearance and introduction to Gliatech's first commercial product in the United States," president and chief executive officer Thomas Oesterling said in a statement.
ADCON-L was developed to inhibit postsurgical adhesions following back surgery, Gliatech said.
Gliatech said ADCON-L was evaluated in a multicenter pivotal trial involving 267 evaluable patients at nine European academic medical centers, the company said.
The study led to the gel's approval in the European Union, Australia and New Zealand, Gliatech said.
